text: A fresh loaf of luck is rising in your oven.
Tomorrow brings a quiet morning and a good cup of tea.
The crumbs you leave today feed the birds of tomorrow.
Your next idea will fit in a single commit.
A small bug, fixed early, saves a long night.
Someone will thank you tomorrow for the notes you write today.
The oven is hot: bake the hard part first.
A clean diff is a kind message to your future self.
Patience and flour make the best bread.
Good fortune follows those who read the error message.
